decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model range closely aligned with the firm's core safety-footwear strategy of protection, fit and comfort in a growing market, it is likely to stay on the market.

The electrostatic-dissipative occupational shoe fits the firm's established offer and serves a clear workplace need, but as a less prominent and narrower product it is somewhat more exposed to portfolio pruning.
This safety-shoe series is close to the firm's core business and supports its broad product range, so it is more likely to be retained unless overlapping models are consolidated.
